title: 超越情感分析：传统NLP与基于LLM的多维分析在政治新闻评估中的比较
summary: 本文比较了基于RoBERTa的传统情感分析与基于LLM的多维框架分析在50篇政治新闻中的应用。发现传统方法存在“中性崩溃”问题，70%的文章被归类为中性，而LLM方法能捕捉政治偏见、煽情性、情感诉求和框架，更符合社会科学研究需求。
summary_en: This paper compares RoBERTa-based sentiment analysis with an LLM-based multi-dimensional framing analysis on 50 political news articles. It finds traditional methods suffer from 'neutral collapse' (70% classified as neutral), while LLM approaches capture political bias, sensationalism, emotional appeal, and framing, better aligning with social science research needs.
